dialogue:

Person1: I know, right! I loved Wild Hunt but this is like a completely different level?
Person2: It really is. I guess we'll see when the game gets released but for once the NPCs seemed like real people, even the crowds. They said they'd be working on that and now I'm sold.
Person1: Yeah, they didn't move awkwardly or anything, it really felt like the world was alive. I can't wait!!
Person2: It's only a shame about the POV...
Person1: You don't like first-person?
Person2: Well, I guess it's okay at times but I'd prefer over-the-shoulder. They say you can customise everything about your character so I'd kind of like to be able to see my gear because otherwise what's the point.

Person2: Well, I'll still be hoping for an option to switch to third-person...
Person1: I wouldn't really count on that. They seem really committed to their vision and think this is the best choice so people can enjoy the world 100%.
Person2: I'm still not sure but y'know, not gonna hate until it's actually release. It looks really good so far so I'd be happy if they proved me wrong and made me enjoy the POV.
Person1: I just wish they'd tell us the release date already!
Person2: Hmm, who knows... I think it was supposed to be ready this year, so I'm keeping my fingers crossed.
summary: There was a demo gameplay from Cyberpunk 2077 released. Person2 and Person1 like it and can't wait to play the game. Person2 prefers over-the-shoulder view to first-person.

summary: Person1' sister had a heart attack on Tuesday and is recovering in hospital after having 2 stents fitted. Generally the sister is very fit, she walked a 21 km marathon on Sunday.
